title: Grateful Dead Live at Dupont Gymnasium M.I.T. on 1970-05-07
lineage: AudMC > ? > 7 inch Reel > DAT > HD > Soundforge > SHN

ai_review.summary: Fair audience tape with noticeable hiss, but the show shines – a marathon Lovelight, ripping Good Lovin', soaring Easy Wind and an epic The Other One suite.
ai_review.review: Despite the lo‑fi AUD source that leaves some instrument separation muddy, this performance is a Dead highlight. Reviewers rave about the three‑set flow (acoustic, NRPS jam and electric), with the second electric set delivering a blistering Good Lovin', an unforgettable Easy Wind, a powerful The Other One suite and a 31‑minute Lovelight that many call one of the best ever.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviewers give high star ratings (average ~3.9) and praise the musical performance, while noting consistent but not catastrophic recording flaws.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audible hiss and muffled instrument isolation; vocals sometimes harsh but generally audible. Some listeners find the tape “unlistenable,” others appreciate its character.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set concert (acoustic, NRPS jam, electric). The acoustic set and NRPS interlude are praised, the second electric set is highlighted for its energy, and the show closes with a legendary Lovelight.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s solo work gets high marks – shredding on Good Lovin' and stellar steel‑guitar work with NRPS.
